Under Article 3(2) of the Study and Examination Regulations of the University of Pardubice 
and subject to agreement with the deans of the faculties, the academic calendar for the 
2026/2027 academic year is set as follows:  
 
The 2026/2027 academic year will last from 1 September 2026  to 31 August 2027 and will 
be subdivided as follows:  
 
Winter semester from 1 September 2026 to 14 February 2027

may start on different dates, and corresponding adjustments of other dates may be made 
 
The 2027/2028 academic year will start on 1 September 2027. 
 
Under Article 3(2) of the Study and Examination Regulations, individual faculties will 
prepare faculty academic calendars that will be in line with the university academic calendar 
for the 2026/2027 academic year and that will specify the dates for other activities including, 
without limitation, entrance exams and final exams. 
UNIVERSITY OF PARDUBICE 
Rector’s Announcement No. 6/2025 
Title: Academic Calendar for the 2026/2027 Academic Year  
 
Applicability: Students and employees of the University of Pardubice 
Effective date:  12 December 2025
